What we install

Every job starts with your actual power needs and roof, not a fixed package — so quotes below are starting points for the conversation, not the final word.

Panels

Solar panel installation

Rooftop and ground-mount arrays sized to your roof orientation, shading, and load. We handle mounting, wiring, and structural checks so the array holds up through Lagos rain and heat.

Inverters

Inverter installation & sizing

Hybrid and pure sine wave inverters matched to your panel output and daily usage — sized so your fridge, AC, and pumps actually run without the system tripping.

Storage

Battery backup systems

Lithium and tubular battery banks configured for how long you actually need backup — a few hours to bridge outages, or a full day off-grid.

Aftercare

Maintenance & monitoring

Panel cleaning, battery health checks, and inverter diagnostics on a schedule — plus callouts when something's off, so small issues don't become full replacements.

How a project runs

From first call to switch-on, most residential installs complete in one to two weeks.

Step 1

Site assessment

We visit, check your roof, wiring, and current bills to understand real usage.

Step 2

System design & quote

You get a specific panel and inverter recommendation with a fixed price, not a range.

Step 3

Installation

Our technicians mount panels, run wiring, and install the inverter and battery bank.

Step 4

Commissioning & handover

We test under real load, walk you through the system, and set up a maintenance plan.
